derivation_note: Derived from the frozen graded episode records (grader: upstream_verbatim). 'solo' holds, per task, the graded outcome, the two measured cost fields (cost_usd_pinned: provider-pinned pricing; cost_usd_litellm: litellm pricing; USD) and the agent step count for each of the three solo fixer arms over the full 266-task set. 'system_union_pairs' holds the same for every (task, fixer) pair executed with the SuperScout system (searcher handoff + fixer): the 331 pairs of the frozen union run plus 33 post-hoc episodes marked post_hoc: true (30 Kimi K2.5 + handoff and 3 Gemini 3 Flash + handoff), run after the 2026-07-30 evaluation freeze under the same official capped protocol (same frozen stripped handoffs, same frozen harness image, same grader). With them, Kimi K2.5 + handoff covers all 266 tasks and every task routed by the theta=0.30 router in routing_scenarios.json has a measured episode for its routed fixer. The router cell recomputes by joining routing_scenarios.json decisions against system_union_pairs (159/266 solved); the no-router blanket Kimi K2.5 + handoff reference recomputes from the 266 Kimi entries (159/266 solved). Cost conventions in the frozen receipts: paired_outcomes.json per-row costs and the GPT/Opus arm totals ($151.64/$201.25) are litellm-priced; the Kimi arm total ($28.23) and the router-cell fixer costs are pinned-priced. No value was invented; all fields are copied from the graded records. Cross-checked in staging against paired_outcomes.json (resolved/steps exact, costs to receipt rounding); the router-cell join and the blanket-Kimi recomputation above were re-verified after the post-hoc extension (159/266 each, fixer cost to $0.01).
